description: End-to-end protocol regression: the sim runs behind the mmc-proto TCP server, the host connects like it would to hardware, streams telemetry at 1 kHz, and commands a 0.5 A q-axis step over the wire.
notes: Captured live from mmc-sim (Sim) over mmc-proto; 1001 frames.
title: TCP live capture — 0.5 A step
